experience.title: Accounting Assistant
experience.heading: A foundation in cash and records.
experience.narrative: Daily transaction entry in QuickBooks Desktop, branch cash monitoring and sales reconciliation formed the foundation of her accounting work.
experience.scope: Recorded transactions, compared cash-monitoring reports with theoretical sales, tracked deposit slips and reviewed daily bank statements.
experience.control: Kept supporting receipts, vouchers and financial documents organized alongside branch cash records.

experience.title: Accounting Assistant
experience.heading: Broader payment and payroll responsibilities.
experience.narrative: Her scope expanded into vendor payments, payroll, cash disbursement and daily collection reconciliation.
experience.scope: Processed payment requests, prepared cash and check vouchers, handled employee payroll and monitored accounts payable.
experience.control: Reconciled cash-on-delivery and cash-on-pickup transactions, monitored petty cash and revolving funds, and followed up on payment items.

experience.title: Accounting Assistant
experience.heading: Financial controls at greater volume.
experience.narrative: She now personally reviews more than 5,000 vendor invoices each month, with responsibility for billing checks and supporting documentation.
experience.scope: Reviews vendor invoices and purchase orders for accuracy, authorization and documentation; checks rental, utility and freight billings.
experience.control: Identifies billing discrepancies, reviews petty cash reconciliations and maintains records for internal and external audits.

skills.name: Microsoft Excel
skills.evidence: PivotTables for summaries, VLOOKUP for matching records and COUNTIF for counting entries. Explore these formulas in the guided Accounting Lab.

skills.name: QuickBooks Desktop
skills.evidence: Professional use at Clargis Food Ventures, 2015–2020: daily transaction entry and financial tracking.
